requirement: The words' "no direct link" predicts falls when a change is forced, and not when it is routed
evidence: Not supported as stated. Dog strength (anat_dog) against old strength (anat_strong), 8 seeds, judged per link: with the pre-registered fall (relative to the reference) the forbid/allow gap doubled (4.9 -> 10.2 points, p = 0.10); but that fall counts lagging behind a fast rise. With an absolute fall (thorax rolled past 60 deg) the links the words forbid are harder by about 10 points forced or routed, at either strength (p 0.06-0.24), routing barely protects and dog strength adds nothing. Falls concentrate in a few start poses rising from down, failing on every seed. Tired (anat_tired at capacity 0.65): the forbid/allow gap widens (topple: routed +8.2 points, p = 0.006, exploratory); pre-registered T2-T4 fail (p 0.13-0.27); routing still doesn't protect
